source.surface: Google OAuth scope grant, lower half of the consent screen with per-scope checkboxes and the two dispositions
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: Cancel, outlined, no fill, blue label — visually identical construction to Continue
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: scope rows sit on plain white; the only saturated colour on the surface is the checked state of the scope checkboxes and an informational callout
decisionColour.optionalGrantDefault: checked — every scope checkbox is in its on state before the user acts
decisionColour.verdict: The strongest instance of equal-weight dispositions in the corpus: Cancel and Continue are the same size, the same shape, both outlined, neither filled, so the surface expresses no preference about which way to decide. It is also a counter-instance on defaults, because every scope arrives pre-granted.
